text: Bitcoin's modest gain masks Ethereum's stronger outperformance, suggesting conviction is shifting toward Layer 1 alternatives and DeFi exposure. Despite the 24-hour rallies, the Fear & Greed index sits firmly in fear territory with deteriorating 7-day momentum, indicating this bounce lacks broad conviction. BTC dominance holding at 59.5% with $97B volume shows the market is testing support levels rather than committing to sustained risk-on positioning.
